  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;"><i>Operating Activities</i></span></p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
  <div style="font-size: 10pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">
   <span style="color:#000000;">Cash used in&#160;operating activities is significantly influenced by the amount of cash we invest in personnel and infrastructure to support the anticipated growth of our business. Our working capital consists primarily of cash, receivables from tenants, prepaid expenses, accounts payable, accrued compensation, accrued other expenses, and&#160;lease liabilities. The&#160;timing of collection of our tenant receivables, and the timing of spending commitments and payments of our accounts payable, accrued expenses, accrued payroll and related benefits, all affect these account balances.</span>
  </div>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">&#160;Net cash used in operating activities was approximately $3.9 million for the </span><span style="color:#000000;">three months ended March 31, 2026</span><span style="color:#000000;">, as compared to cash used in operating activities of approximately $5.1&#160;million for the same period in </span><span style="color:#000000;">2025</span><span style="color:#000000;">. The approximately $1.1&#160;million decrease&#160;in cash used in operating activities was primarily attributable to an approximately $1.2 million decrease in net loss, net of non-cash adjustments, offset by an unfavorable change in working capital of approximately $0.1 million. The decrease&#160;in net loss, net of non-cash adjustments was primarily driven by the impact of increases in revenue from our&#160;operations at DVT, APA, and ADS. The unfavorable change in working capital was primarily driven by the timing of collections of accounts receivable as well as spending commitments and payments of our accounts payable and other accrued expenses.</span></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;"><i>Investing Activities</i></span></p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">Our primary investing activities have consisted of payments related to the cost of construction at our various hangar campus development projects and investment in U.S. Treasury Securities. As our business&#160;expands, we expect to continue to invest in our current and anticipated future portfolio of hangar campus development projects.</span></p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">&#160;Net cash used in investing activities was approximately $126.9&#160;million for the </span><span style="color:#000000;">three months ended March 31, 2026</span><span style="color:#000000;">, as compared to cash used&#160;in&#160;investing activities of approximately $4.5 million for the same period in </span><span style="color:#000000;">2025</span><span style="color:#000000;">. The increase of approximately $122.4&#160;million of cash used in investing activities was driven primarily by an increase in purchases of available-for-sale and held-to-maturity securities of $63.9 million due to the investment of certain Series 2026 Bonds proceeds, a&#160;decrease in proceeds received from available-for-sale investments of approximately $49.9 million, and an increase of&#160;capital expenditures of&#160;approximately $8.4&#160;million.</span></p>
  <p style="font-family:'Times New Roman';font-size:10pt;font-variant:normal;margin:0pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;"><i>Financing Activities</i></span></p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">Our primary financing activities have consisted of capital raised to fund the growth of our business and&#160;proceeds from debt obligations incurred to finance our hangar campus development projects. We expect to raise additional equity capital and issue additional indebtedness as our business grows.</span></p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: Times New Roman; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">Net cash provided by financing activities was approximately&#160;$174.9 million&#160;for the </span><span style="color:#000000;">three months ended March 31, 2026</span><span style="color:#000000;">, as compared to net cash used in financing activities of approximately $1.2 million&#160;for the same period in </span><span style="color:#000000;">2025</span><span style="color:#000000;">. The approximately $176.1&#160;million increase in net cash used in financing activities was primarily driven by proceeds received from the issuance of the Series 2026 Bonds of $150.0 million and approximately $29.0 million of proceeds received from the Term Loan Facility and 2026 Yorkville Promissory Note. These were offset by&#160;an increase of $3.9&#160;million in payments for debt issuance costs.</span></p>

  <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-indent: 0pt; text-align: justify;"><span style="color:#000000;"><b>Evaluation of Disclosure Controls and Procedures</b></span></p>
  <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">Disclosure controls and procedures are controls and other procedures that are designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed in our reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act, is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the SEC&#8217;s rules and forms. Disclosure controls and procedures include, without limitation, controls and procedures designed to ensure that information required to be disclosed in company reports filed or submitted under the Exchange Act is accumulated and communicated to management, including our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.</span></p>
  <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</p>
  <p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;; font-size: 10pt; font-variant: normal; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><span style="color:#000000;">In connection with the preparation of this Form 10-Q, as required by Rules 13a-15 and 15d-15 under the Exchange Act, our Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer carried out an evaluation of the effectiveness of the design and operation of our disclosure controls and procedures as of </span><span style="color:#000000;">March 31, 2026</span><span style="color:#000000;">. Based on that evaluation, our CEO and CFO concluded that our disclosure controls and procedures are effective to ensure that information required to be disclosed by us in reports that we file or submit under the Exchange Act is recorded, processed, summarized and reported within the time periods specified in the SEC's rules and forms, and is accumulated and communicated to our management, including our CEO and CFO, to allow timely decisions regarding required disclosure.</span></p>
